field.label: Page Views Page View Start Date
field.name: page_views.page_view_start_date

dashboard_elements.body_text:
Filter - Date: Input the date range you want to view results for. Results are broken down by individual days. Results are currently available for the last completed 24 months. Go to the online guide for instructions.
View or Download More Rows/Columns of Data: The current live view limit is 20 rows & 20 columns. To view or download more rows/columns of data, use the "Advanced data options" of the "Download Data" option. Go to the online guide for instructions.
Note: Results are filtered to include Campaign and Medium UTM codes that contain: BCC, BCSC, CCPP, TeamsBG, Order. If additional UTM codes are added, please contact the Analytics team who can update the dashboard to ensure all results are captured.
